seo.title: Innovorder & Edenred
seo.description: By integrating Edenred with Innovorder online ordering and joining the Ticket Restaurant network, your restaurant is guaranteed to attract more customers, generate more orders and increase your sales.

fields.text-17px: By integrating Edenred with Innovorder online ordering and joining the Ticket Restaurant network, your restaurant is guaranteed to attract more customers, generate more orders and increase your sales.
fields.24-rt-gradient-html: The creators of the Ticket Restaurant, Edenred offers innovative payment solutions for employees and retailers, and represents 50% of the meal voucher market.
fields.rt-features-integration-html:
• Increase your sales by attracting more customers
  • Offer a unique online ordering experience
  • Simplify your accounting management with the same reports for all your online transactions
  • Save time by managing your Ticket Restaurant business from our dedicated area
  • Easily reimburse your customers in case of need
fields.cta-sub-kiosk: Develop your restaurant's appeal, increase your visibility and manage your online ordering business simply by integrating Edenred into your Innovorder ecosystem.
